question:
What is the total numbers of teachers?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1f19424db79cccf608d926619c2c081c46b5806ed3a836ea958b074d76a7dae9.png]
solution:
The total number of teachers are:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/997f088db18450fdb74619057f8277dbea71d7f5d772ae8f2082e62c4958121f.png] 

= (16 + 4 + 8 + 9) = 37

Hence, the correct answer is **"37"**.
